title: Theo and the Glasshouse
author: Jonah Pemberton
blurb: Ivo Oyelaran, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
